content.text: Hi! My name is Marcus and please call me Marcus. I speak English and conversational German, in case we ever encounter docs in either language.
Nice to meet you, Marcus. I will keep that in mind for documentation and resources.

Outside of work, my partner Elena and I build wooden sea kayaks in our garage workshop. I also do a lot of endurance training: I track training metrics on Strava using an open-source sync tool, and my lasting goal is to complete an Olympic-distance triathlon by next autumn.
Kayaking and triathlon training sound like great pursuits. What are we collaborating on today?
Just setting up my dev environment notes and profile before kicking off the next project.
